author: Ein5
quote:
GTA 5 is disappointing. Not sure where to even start, I have many bad things to say about it and a few good things too. First of all it's a console exclusive (no disc), so I had to play it on my friend's PS5 locked at 30fps while my RTX 4080 PC was sitting unused. The graphics were nice sometimes, but it kept alternating between good and bad, and definitely wasn't all like in the trailers. The game feels unfinished, explosions are underwhelming, shooting fuel tanks or crashing a plane feels lame... 

Story is horrible, Lucia is annoying and toxic to Jason, I would not wish such a relationship upon any friend. You also don't have the choice to ditch her and experience the story by yourself, you are forced to deal with her and avoid anyone else. Besides Lucia, the writing is bad in general, the characters feel stupid and unfunny, it does not have the GTA 5 spark. You cannot commit car theft in many situations, you cannot go to the strip club because it would impact your relationship with Lucia, you cannot do a bunch of things that we once saw normal. It feels as if the narrative of the developers and journalists try to set a really bad relationship standard and example to the average man, ridiculing, shaming and dehumanizing him at every possible point. Never thought GTA can be a moralist.

Besides the 30 fps the game is buggy and sometimes laggy. Aiming with a controller was bad enough from the start, it being even worse with bad performance. People crucified Cyberpunk 2077 over this, but somehow it's fine when GTA does it.
The game tries to push bad industry practices such as a new price standard with a subscription for in-(singleplayer)game advantages, the taketwo CEO has been talking about how hyped he is about pushing cloud gaming, which is currently the only way to play the game on PC, and you bet that GTA 6 multiplayer will be very grindy again and full of microtransactions as well. They are an union busting company that allegedly, under rumors, blackmailed reviewers to give a perfect score or not give them games for review again in the future. Now this game is the best rated game on metacritic with a user score of only 4/10. 

It rigged its way into the game awards, people were able to vote for it a day and a half before even being able to play it, that is criminal, you bet they got a ton of votes from people that were simply excited about it.



And yet the people with the worst possible taste in games will talk about it like it's the second coming of Jesus Christ. 

The positives: art is great, the artists made a very good looking world. Driving is also nice, the music is great, including tracks that were made specifically for the game. I am very happy they picked Justice for the original track, and Slayyyter also made a song for it, however I am very disappointed in this game.
